2607.09880.title: CLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
2607.09880.paper_summary: Clinical time series are central to patient monitoring, risk assessment, and clinical decision support. However, they are often sparse, irregularly sampled, and asynchronous, making it difficult for models to identify the temporal evidence required for clinical Question Answering (QA). Existing benchmarks primarily focus on regularly sampled time-series QA or medical QA over static data, and therefore rarely assess whether models can faithfully ground their answers in irregular temporal observations. To fill this gap, we introduce CLIR-Bench, a benchmark for irregular clinical time series QA constructed from de-identified ICU records through a principled four-stage pipeline. CLIR-Bench contains 6,600 QA instances spanning 11 clinical variables, organized into four capability dimensions and 11 tasks. Each question is linked to explicit temporal evidence and task-specific answer derivation rules, enabling evaluation of both answer accuracy and evidence use. Experiments show that existing generalist models struggle to retrieve and reason over sparse clinical evidence, highlighting the need for stronger irregular time-series reasoning methods. Our code and data are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/winall/CLIR-Bench.
2607.09880.paper_summary_zh: 臨床時間序列在病人監測、風險評估和臨床決策支持中扮演著核心角色。<lb/>然而，它們通常是稀疏的、不規則取樣的和非同步的，這使得模型難以識別臨床問題回答（QA）所需的時間證據。<lb/>現有的基準主要集中在定期取樣的時間序列QA或靜態數據上的醫療QA，因此很少評估模型是否能夠忠實地將其答案基於不規則的時間觀察。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們介紹了CLIR-Bench，這是一個基於去識別的ICU記錄通過一個有原則的四階段流程構建的不規則臨床時間序列QA基準。<lb/>CLIR-Bench包含6600個QA實例，涵蓋11個臨床變量，組織成四個能力維度和11個任務。<lb/>每個問題都與明確的時間證據和特定任務的答案推導規則相關聯，從而能夠評估答案的準確性和證據的使用。<lb/>實驗表明，現有的通用模型在檢索和推理稀疏的臨床證據方面面臨困難，突顯了對更強的不規則時間序列推理方法的需求。<lb/>我們的代碼和數據可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/winall/CLIR-Bench獲得。
